text: Basic medicine is the core foundation of medical science, focusing on the mechanisms of human body structure, function and the occurrence and development of diseases, and providing theoretical support for application fields such as clinical medicine, preventive medicine and pharmacy. This discipline takes anatomy, physiology, pathology and other disciplines as its pillars, and combines cutting-edge technologies such as molecular biology and genetics to study human life activities and pathological processes from the macroscopic (systems and organs) to the microscopic (molecules and cells) levels. This major aims to cultivate talents with solid medical basic theories, experimental skills and scientific research thinking, focusing on analyzing the essence of diseases. Common branches include human anatomy, physiology, pathology, pathophysiology, immunology, microbiology, pharmacology, etc.
